title: Using ChatGPT to Save Time on Job Applications ✍️
description:
We’re all about saving as much time as possibie on all the writing of a job search…and there is ALOT of it. On job applications especially so many questions often ask you to recite resume information so you can use ChatGPT to quickly write the response. You will be pasting in your resume with the prompt so the accuracy should be pretty good but as always you will want to read through the results before sending them off. #chatgpt #chatgpt3 #jobapplication #jobapplications #jobapplicationtips #jobsearchtips #jobsearch #careertok #resumetips
